text:
maria: Pre-cutover rollcall for EU midnight slice. Need signalboard owner, rollback lead, smoke runner, and migration watcher. brief please. :eyes:
release-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 00:00 UTC -> 00:40 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 10m, 20% for 15m, then ramp. Pin to v4.0.0-rc3 on prod.
simon: I will own signalboard and post minute ticks in #release-war-room. Ill watch errors and tail traces.
alice: On-call. Im rollback lead. Rollback conditions in short:
- error-rate > 1.2% sustained for 2 consecutive 5m windows
- p50 latency > 2x baseline for 10m
If triggered, Ill run rollback-playbook and notify SRE.
paul: Observability + smoke. Ill kick the synthetic suite after canary warmup and watch APM for new error signatures.
teju: Ill handle DB migrations and cache prewarm. Migration plan snippet:
```
# run migration in staging then prod dry-run
./scripts/migrate --env=prod --dry-run || exit 1
# then apply
./scripts/migrate --env=prod --apply
```
devops-bot: Build 10234 deployed to canary cluster. Smoke started: https://ci.redwood/build/10234 :white_check_mark:
maria: Escape hatch rules (short):
- immediate rollback if alice triggers by conditions above
- manual unpin can be done by release lead + oncall (maria + alice)
- if rollback causes data drift, we cut hotfix branch and run data-repair flow
simon: Signalboard update cadence: every 5 minutes or on status change. Will tag @alice for FAIL.
paul: Canary A smoke green. Synthetic user flows passed. KV hit-rate 97.6%.
teju: Migration dry-run 0 errors, apply took 3s, no locks. Prewarm complete.
release-bot: Pin applied: prod -> v4.0.0-rc3. Fallback: v3.9.8 if capacity or perf regressions.
olga: I'll shadow the rollout in APAC and validate feature flags are off for legacy tenants.
alice: Setting auto-unpin timer: 25m post-deploy unless manual ack. I'm watching the clock.
maria: Post-release checklist URL: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RD-4500. Add notes live.
simon: Final check: thumbs? :thumbsup:
paul: +1 smoke green
teju: +1 migrations ok
olga: +1 flags validated
alice: +1 oncall ready
release-bot: Deploy started. Routing 5% to canary.
simon: Canary OK at 5%. Monitoring p50/p95 and error-rate.
devops-bot: Canary metrics: error-rate 0.35%, p50 +10%. No new exceptions.
paul: Observability: traces clean, no new error groups. Synthetics all green.
alice: Note: if we see sustained error-rate drift >0.8% for 10m, prepare for rollback. I'll call it.
simon: Promoted to 20%. Holding for 15m.
maria: Keep updates status-first (OK/WARN/FAIL). If FAIL, ping @alice and tag #incident.
simon: 10m in, status OK.
devops-bot: Canary metrics at 20%: error-rate 0.5%, p50 +12%
paul: No anomalies in spans. Release notes appended: performance note and observability links.
teju: Warm caches holding, migrations stable.
alice: Still green. If we stay green to +40m we do quiet rollforward.
maria: Thanks team. If anything pops, short messages and immediate ping. Otherwise we run full rollforward at +40m. :rocket:
